BMX5: Cortech BevMax Insulated Beverage Dispenser
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-bmx5-bevmax-beverage-dispenser
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/bevmax/
Spec sheet: BMX5
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech BevMax Insulated Beverage Dispenser – BMX5
Current H1: Cortech BevMax Beverage Dispenser - BMX5
Subtitle: Stackable 5-Gallon Insulated Beverage Dispenser with a Lockable Twist-On Lid
Current subtitle: Cortech USA BMX5BN, BMX5GY, BMX5BK, BMX5GT, BMX5OR BevMax Beverage Dispenser
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech BevMax Insulated Beverage Dispenser holds 5 gallons of hot or cold drinks for meal service in correctional facilities, schools, and other high-volume settings. It is insulated to keep hot drinks hot and cold drinks cold, and it needs no gaskets.
The housing and lid are both rotationally molded in one piece from high density polyethylene made with FDA-approved material. The twist-on lid takes a key or combination lock or a tie wrap for a tamper-resistant closure, and the dispensers stack to save space.
Material: One-piece seamless housing and lid, rotationally molded from high density polyethylene
Capacity: 5 gallons
Dimensions: 17½”W×17½”D×19½”H
Weight: 18 lbs empty
Insulation: Insulated for temperature retention; no gaskets required
Lid: Twist-on lid accepts key or combination locks or tie wraps for a tamper-resistant closure
Spigot: Heavy duty 2-way vented spigot with 4¼” clearance; fits most 8 to 10 oz cups
Handles: Molded-in handles for carrying and lifting
Stacking: Stackable
Food Safety: Made with FDA-approved material
Colors: Brown, Gray, Black, Orange, or Granite (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: 3-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
BMX5BN – Brown: 5-gallon BevMax
BMX5GY – Gray: 5-gallon BevMax
BMX5BK – Black: 5-gallon BevMax
BMX5GT – Granite: 5-gallon BevMax
BMX5OR – Orange: 5-gallon BevMax
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The BevMax suits facilities that serve bulk drinks and need a dispenser that stands up to hard use and can be locked.
Typical applications include:
Inmate meal service in prisons, jails, and detention centers
Central kitchens and dining halls
Schools, universities, and other high-volume food service
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (63 characters): Cortech BevMax Insulated Beverage Dispenser - BMX5 at Anchortex
Meta description (144 characters): Shop the Cortech BevMax. A stackable 5-gallon insulated beverage dispenser molded in one piece, with a lockable twist-on lid and a 2-way spigot.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the BevMax Insulated Beverage Dispenser, so I added "Insulated."
Weight: your variants are set to 28 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 18 lbs empty, so I used 18 lbs.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 3-year factory warranty, so I added it.
Cup size: "fits most 8 to 10 oz cups" comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention it.
Granite: the Cortech spec sheet lists Granite (BMX5GT), but the Cortech web page does not. I kept your Granite variant. Can you check it is still available?
I left out "toughest, most durable bulk beverage dispenser available" and "virtually indestructible," since these are marketing claims.
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has three more photos: the BevMax in brown, stacked, and in granite. Would you like me to add them?
